text_block_list.text:
One day, curious about a bargain sale, I 
went to check it out on my own.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Daaamn it all~! I had no idea it'd turn 
into such a brutal brawl...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thinkin' about the family budget, I can't 
just back down, but... this situation is――
choice_data_list: Looks like you have your hands full.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, it's you. Fancy meetin' you here――

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Grrrgh, I ain't giving up~! Not till I 
get my hands on what I'm afterrrr...!
choice_data_list: Catch the flow of the crowd!
Let's catch the flow of the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Grrrgh, I ain't giving up~! Not till I 
get my hands on what I'm afterrrr...!
choice_data_list: Catch the flow of the crowd!
Let's catch the flow of the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, yer right! Just like in a race, 
gotta look real close...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Now's the time! I'm swingin' around from 
the inside to make my move!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Take this, take this, take thiiiis! I'll 
show ya the true grit of Naniwaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... I thought I was gonna 
get crushed~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Didja see my footwork, though?! Must've 
blown past 15 folks in one go!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that right? Praise me more, praise 
me moreee!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, ya got a point there. Time to 
withdraw from the frontline for now!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The opponent's onto my moves too…… 
Chargin' in head-on'll just get me blown 
away.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ye gotta be extra careful around that 
auntie in the tiger-print topââ"Iron 
Wall Michiyo."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Blocking rivals' paths so tight they can 
never squeeze past... that one's pretty 
famous among the regulars.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
To get what I'm after without runnin' into 
Michiyo... Alright, this is the route!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm headin' back out! Burn the 
way I live into your memory!!
